text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Curren Chan...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, awesome!
There are so many Umamusume plushies~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Curren Chan is pointing, I see
a crane game filled with plushies
themed after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: You're right, it is cute, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, Onii-chan.
Don't you think a cute plushie is just perfect
for a cute girl?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, Onee-chan.
Don't you think a cute plushie is just perfect
for a cute girl?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If Curren has them around, she feels like
she could be waaay cuter, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder how hard Onii-chan will work
for Curren's sake?
I can't wait to see~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder how hard Onee-chan will work
for Curren's sake?
I can't wait to see~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
